title: OrderFlow
description: US-equities order-flow print (aggressor side + large-trade flag). Topic: order_flow. aggressor uses the same buy|sell vocabulary as raw_tick — no side / taker_side aliases. symbol is uppercase, no hyphens. ts_ms is UTC epoch milliseconds.

symbol.description: Global schema: uppercase, no hyphens (e.g. AAPL).

aggressor.description: Taker side. Same vocabulary as raw_tick.aggressor. Signed volume = +volume if buy, -volume if sell.

is_large.description: True when notional (or volume) exceeds the connector large-trade threshold.

notional.description: price * volume when the producer computed it.
